tool_trajectory.result: I want to keep the scan with the best overall quality, which includes both high coverage and low noise, as defined by the Scan Quality Score (SQS) calculation.

args.sql:
WITH sqs AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref, 
    (coverpct * (100 - noisedb)) AS sqs,
    questregistry
  FROM 
    scanpointcloud AS spc
    JOIN scans AS s ON spc.arcref = s.arcref
) 
SELECT 
  arcref, 
  MAX(sqs) AS max_sqs, 
  questregistry
FROM 
  sqs
GROUP BY 
  arcref;
